prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop browser-extension review workspace comp
Primary request: Design BugReceipt's Export Ledger prototype: a real, shippable evidence-review product UI with a guided three-stage workflow, "1 Report", "2 Evidence", "3 Export check". The active Evidence stage fills the central canvas; a persistent ruled export ledger spans the bottom and lists exactly what will leave the device.
Input image: visual identity reference only—carry over its cool paper/fog surfaces, deep ink, coral signal, teal trace, square geometry, editorial Bricolage-like headings, compact mono metadata, thin rules, and evidence density. Do not reuse its layout, content, old version, or obsolete email-sharing action.
Composition/framing: 16:10 desktop application viewport, edge-to-edge product UI, not a device mockup and not a presentation board. Slim top product header; clear horizontal three-stage rail; large visual evidence canvas with one selected failure frame; quiet report synopsis; bottom receipt ledger with rows "Screen recording", "Selected frame", "Console 3", "Network 2", "5 values redacted", and a primary "Continue to export check" action.
Text (verbatim where legible): "BugReceipt", "Review capture", "Report", "Evidence", "Export check", "Report stays local", "Selected frame", "Console 3", "Network 2", "5 values redacted", "Continue to export check".
Style/medium: realistic production UI screenshot, precise accessible typography, dense but calm operational interface.
Constraints: one dominant focal task; square controls; no gradients, glass, rounded cards, fake testimonials, cloud upload, email sharing, Chrome Web Store claim, or decorative dashboard charts; no watermark.
